item.title: SCP-XXXX: All Dogs go to Heaven
item.content:encoded:
This is my first attempt at my first SCP, please critique everything you can! Here's the sandbox:
http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/actually-god

The idea is based on the popular idea that "all dogs go to heaven." Any and all feedback is appreciated and helpful!
